title: A Ladybug Walker
body: A ladybug lands on the 100-cm mark of a measuring stick and makes five displacements: $$15$$ cm toward the floor, $$56$$ cm toward the ceiling, $$3$$ cm toward the floor, $$25$$ cm toward the floor, and $$19$$ cm toward the ceiling. Find the vector of its total displacement and its final resting position on the stick. The 0-cm end of the stick rests on the floor. Let the $$+\hat{u}$$-direction $$be$$ $$downwards$$ $$towards$$ $$the$$ $$floor$$ $$and$$ $$let$$ $$the$$ $$-\hat{u}\$\$-direction$$ $$be$$ $$upwards$$ $$towards$$ $$the$$ $$ceiling$$.
